jobs.title: Software Engineer, Security Focus
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on full-stack Software Engineer who will focus primarily on security remediation. Your first priority will be owning the remediation of vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing: not just reporting findings, but digging into the codebase, session traffic, and infrastructure to fix the underlying issues and prevent them from recurring. You will work closely with engineering and design teams to translate real-world security findings into concrete, testable requirements in our Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs), and you will personally implement or oversee the fixes.

This is an engineering role first. As the security backlog comes under control, you will have the flexibility to contribute to application development across our Ruby on Rails and React platform, bringing a security-minded perspective to the features you build.

Key ResponsibilitiesSecurity Remediation

* Vulnerability Remediation: Own end-to-end remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced by penetration tests and other security assessments, from triage through verified fix.
* Traffic and Session Analysis: Use browser-based code inspection tools to examine session traffic between the front end and back end, identify cases where excessive or sensitive information is being exposed, and translate those findings into concrete design and engineering requirements.
* TRD Input: Feed vulnerability findings and remediation requirements directly into the Technical Requirements Document (TRD) process so fixes are captured as durable design requirements, not one-off patches.
* Session Management: Review and harden session management practices across the application stack.
* Full-Stack Remediation: Work within a Ruby on Rails and React codebase and across containerized services (AWS, Fargate) to implement fixes at both the application and infrastructure layers.
* API and Real-Time Systems: Assess and secure real-time and API-driven features, including those built on Pusher and AnyCable, and RESTful APIs generally.
* Documentation: Produce clear, thorough documentation of vulnerabilities, root causes, remediation steps, and verification results.
* Compliance Support: Contribute security context and vocabulary to FedRAMP-related discussions and requirements, partnering with compliance and engineering stakeholders.

Application Development

* Feature Development: Design, build, and ship features across the Ruby on Rails back end and React front end alongside the broader engineering team.
* Secure by Design: Apply what you learn from remediation work to new development, helping the team avoid reintroducing known classes of vulnerabilities.
* Code Quality: Participate in code reviews, testing, and technical design discussions, with an eye toward both security and maintainability.

  
**Requirements**  
Engineering Experience

* 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with broad full-stack work across multiple applications and technology layers.
* Working proficiency in Ruby on Rails and React.
* Experience with containerized environments, AWS, and Fargate.
* Solid API experience, including RESTful API design and security considerations.
* Hands-on experience with Pusher and AnyCable, or comparable real-time messaging technologies.
* Knowledge of Ruby data models and how schema and query design affect performance and scalability.

Security Experience

* 5+ years of experience in a security engineering or closely related role.
* Proven experience remediating vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing.
* AWS Security certification(s) (e.g., AWS Certified Security – Specialty).
* General familiarity with FedRAMP: enough understanding of the vocabulary and framework to contribute meaningfully to a FedRAMP-related project.

Analytical Skills

* Comfortable using browser developer/code inspection tools to inspect network and session traffic.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs.

Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, Tower Research, PDT Partners, SIG, and other top quantitative firms.

We're looking for a midlevel or senior IC to join our Backend Engineering team as a Site Reliability Engineer. You'll own the uptime, performance, and observability of our platform, and help set the standard for how the rest of engineering builds, ships, and monitors software.

The range of problems is wide. You'll work on petabyte-scale data processing, SaaS problems like customer management and billing, and the query systems that power our APIs. Unlike most finance firms, we're open about our tech and how we build it.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own uptime, SLAs, and SLOs across our API and platform services.
* Set reliability and operational best practices for other developers without slowing them down.
* Build and maintain observability across logging, metrics, and tracing.
* Design and run high-availability deployment and containerization strategies.
* Profile and optimize Python applications for throughput, latency, and cost.
* Debug production issues down to the OS level using tools like strace, perf, eBPF, ss, and gdb.
* Improve deployment and CI/CD workflows.
* Join the on-call rotation, lead incident response, and run post-incident reviews.
* Find what needs fixing on your own, then take projects from idea to completion.

### **Preferred background**

* Full-time experience in SRE, DevOps, or backend engineering, preferably at a trading firm, tech company, or high-growth startup.
* Hands-on experience with observability tooling for logging, metrics, and tracing (e.g. Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, VictoriaMetrics, Jaeger, Logstash, Loki, Vector).
* Experience with containerization and high availability deployment (e.g. Docker, Podman, Docker Compose, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes, k3s).
* Strong proficiency in Python, including application development and performance optimization.
* Comfortable with Linux debugging and profiling tools such as strace, perf, eBPF, ss, and gdb.

We offer health, dental, disability, and life insurance benefits, as well as 401(k) matching for full-time employees. We accommodate 100% remote work, with teammates living around the globe and paid in their local currency.

The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$215,000, benchmarked to Tier 1 locations in each country. Total compensation may also include bonuses, commissions, and equity, depending on the role.

jobs.description:
### **About Northbeam**

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a **mid-level software engine**er who leans backend and enjoys building features end to end. You'll spend roughly 70% of your time on backend work and 20–30% on frontend, which gives you the ability to carry a feature across the stack rather than handing it off.

You'll help build out new products and capabilities as they grow — implementing backend services alongside the frontend components needed to deliver complete product experiences. That work could include contributing to our new incrementality offering as it expands into a scalable experimentation platform, helping build near real-time data infrastructure, or bringing AI into our marketing users' workflows. You'll work day to day with a cross-functional team of data scientists, product managers, and designers, and with senior engineers who will help you grow into larger architectural decisions.

### **Your Impact**

* Contribute to our new incrementality product as it grows into a reliable, repeatable experimentation platform.
* Help build near-real-time ingestion and processing capabilities as we move beyond batch workflows.
* Build AI-powered workflows that help marketers evaluate performance and act on insights.
* Improve connection-state systems and help extend the partner ecosystem across data ingestion and exports.
* Work on other product areas such as role-based access control (RBAC).
* Contribute to frontend work when needed to deliver complete experiences.

### **What You Bring**

* 3+ years of experience building backend services, APIs, and/or data processing systems in **Python.**
* Exposure to distributed systems or microservices, and curiosity about how larger architectures fit together.
* Experience working alongside product managers, designers, and data scientists, and owning your implementation through to production.
* Comfort in a fast-moving or early-stage environment where priorities shift and engineers pick up whatever the product needs.
* Experience taking defined product requirements and turning them into working, production-ready code.
* The ability to work through unfamiliar datasets and interconnected tables to investigate issues and trace dependencies, with support when the path isn't obvious.
* Working frontend experience with technologies such as React and TypeScript; **deep frontend specialization is not required.**
* Strong coding fundamentals and real problem-solving instincts, with AI used as an accelerator rather than a substitute for core capabilities.
* A generalist mindset and willingness to work across backend, frontend, pipelines, and infrastructure when the product requires it.

### **You may be a strong fit if**

* Most of your experience is in **data-intensive** backend engineering, but you have also shipped frontend work.

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

**Interview Process**  
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Software Developer - ArtDaily Platform Modernization
jobs.description:
Software Developer – ArtDaily.com Platform Modernization

**Company:** ArtDaily News Inc.

**Location:** Austin, Texas (Remote)

**Job Type:** Part-Time / Contract

**Compensation:** $25–$45 per hour, depending on experience

**Schedule:** Flexible

About ArtDaily

ArtDaily.com is a long-established international online newspaper covering art, museums, exhibitions, auctions, architecture, photography, archaeology, and the global art market.

Our website has operated for more than 20 years and currently uses a legacy ASP-based publishing system.

We are seeking a talented independent software developer to help us build a modern replacement for our website's backend and editorial publishing platform.

**This is primarily a software development and backend modernization project, not a visual redesign.**

The existing public-facing ArtDaily design should remain substantially unchanged.

Project Responsibilities

Develop a modern content management system that allows editors to create and manage articles, including:

* Headlines and subheadlines
* Article text and formatting
* Main and additional images
* Image captions and photo credits
* Categories and author/source information
* Publication dates and scheduling
* Homepage placement
* SEO information
* Sponsored/promoted content identification

Editors must be able to create, edit, preview, schedule, publish, unpublish, and search articles through a user-friendly administrative interface.

The project also involves migrating ArtDaily's historical content while preserving existing article URLs wherever possible.

Technical Requirements

Experience with several of the following is desirable:

* Backend web development
* Relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server)
* Content management systems
* APIs and data migration
* Modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python
* Cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, or similar)
* CDN, caching, and website performance
* Cloudflare or comparable security solutions
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Git version control, testing, and documentation

We are open to different modern technology stacks, including Python/Django, Node.js/TypeScript, modern .NET, PHP/Laravel, or established CMS frameworks.

Ideal Candidate

We welcome experienced independent developers, talented recent graduates, and advanced computer science students.

We value demonstrated technical ability more than years of employment.

Candidates should be able to show real software projects they have built, explain technical decisions, and work independently.

Experience with legacy systems, content migration, or digital publishing is particularly valuable.

UT Austin students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

How to Apply

Please include your GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of software you have personally developed.

Briefly answer:

* What is the most complicated web application you have personally built?
* Have you developed an administrative panel or content management system?
* What databases have you worked with?
* Have you deployed an application to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or another production server?
* How would you replace an old website backend while keeping the public-facing website largely unchanged?

Opportunity

This is a paid, project-based opportunity with the potential for ongoing work maintaining and improving ArtDaily after the initial modernization.

We are looking for a dependable, technically capable professional interested in building a long-term working relationship with an established international publication.

Language Requirements. We welcome applicants who speak Englesh and Spanish. Candidates may communicate and interview in either language.

Pay: $25.00 - $45.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

**Software Engineer — Full-Stack (Front-End Focused)**
======================================================

**About the company**
---------------------

A fast-growing, fully remote FinTech SaaS company sitting at the intersection of payments and data intelligence — the product helps merchants, and the software platforms they rely on, manage and reduce the cost of processing electronic payments. The team is small, close-knit, and genuinely AI-forward: engineers use agentic development tools day to day, and the culture leans toward mentorship and real autonomy over rigid process. It shows in retention — the engineering team's average tenure runs about four years, with zero voluntary attrition.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Software Engineer to join a small, high-trust engineering team and take real ownership of the front-end product experience. This is a full-stack role that is heavily front-end weighted in practice — you'll spend most of your time in the UI layer, with occasional backend exposure. You'll be this team's first dedicated front-end hire reporting to the front-end lead, so there's a genuine opportunity to shape how the role and the front-end practice grow from here.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own front-end features end to end — from UI/UX implementation through shipping — using JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and React (Vite as the build tool).
* Work on outlying UI services that consume shared backend services and present data to users, ramping toward independently handling most non-architectural tickets (form changes, UX changes supporting new backend features) within your first few months.
* Collaborate with a small backend-leaning engineering team (Java/Scala/C# exposure is a plus, not a requirement) to integrate front-end work with core product services.
* Use AI development tools as a normal part of your workflow — the team actively encourages this — while being able to verify and stand behind your own understanding of what you ship.
* 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with genuine depth in JavaScript/TypeScript and React; Vite experience is a plus.
* Comfortable working with real autonomy: someone who can take direction, incorporate feedback quickly, and then run with a piece of work without needing close supervision.
* Adaptable to a small-company pace and ambiguity — prior experience at a smaller, fast-moving company is a plus.
* Genuine, thoughtful use of AI coding tools: able to use them productively while still catching and correcting their mistakes yourself.
* Backend exposure (Java, Scala, or C#) is a bonus, not a gate — this is primarily a front-end role.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* 100% remote, with roughly two weeks per year of company travel for in-person team gatherings.
* Candidates based near Salt Lake City UT, Philadelphia PA, or Chicago IL are preferred, but a standout candidate elsewhere will still be considered.

**What we're looking for**

At ProService, we exist to empower employers to succeed in Hawai?i. More than 3,000 local businesses rely on us for payroll, HR, and benefits, and many run their day on tools like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite. When those systems talk cleanly to ours, a restaurant owner closes payroll without re-keying hours. When they don’t, a small business loses time it doesn’t have.

This role owns that connection. You’ll build and run the integrations marketplace that links our customers’ business systems to our HR platform, blending strong engineering with real product ownership. Success looks like customers connecting in minutes, data that stays accurate without manual work, and problems fixed before anyone has to report them.

**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL**

* Design, build, and launch integrations with platforms like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite using OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and polling
* Own the integrations marketplace end to end, including the catalog, connect and disconnect flows, connection health, and a roadmap prioritized with Product
* Architect reusable serverless patterns on AWS (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB) in Python, TypeScript, and React/Next.js so each integration ships faster than the last
* Partner directly with customers on bespoke integrations with ProService APIs, and with vendor developer programs on sandbox access, certification, and API changes
* Build monitoring and alerting that catches sync failures before customers notice
* Uphold code quality through testing, code reviews, and CI/CD, and support production reliability through on-call rotations

**IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?**

This is an ownership role, not a ticket queue. You’ll ship at least one production-ready integration per quarter and keep owning it after launch, including joining the on-call rotation to resolve critical issues within hours. You’ll also talk directly with customers and partners to shape what gets built next. These expectations are not optional — they’re the job. You’ll share them with a team that reviews each other’s code and treats incidents as chances to learn, not to assign blame.

The role also takes patience. Partner APIs change, certifications move at their own pace, and many decisions are judgment calls between fast and durable. The team works on Hawai?i Standard Time, so Southern California candidates should expect a workday that starts mid-morning and runs into the early evening.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM**

You’ve shipped production-grade software in a SaaS or product-driven environment, and you’ve built third-party integrations that stay reliable. That means experience with OAuth 2.0 token lifecycle, webhooks, pagination, data mapping, and vendor API versioning. You’re fluent in AWS serverless, Python, TypeScript, React/Next.js, and Git-based Agile workflows. Accounting, POS, time and labor, or payroll familiarity is a strong plus. So is experience with partner certification programs or with AI/LLM APIs for data mapping.

**You’re probably a fit if:**

* **You enjoy the detective work of making systems agree.** *You trace a mismatched record through logs, payloads, and mappings to its root cause, so the customer’s numbers line up every time after.*
* **You make sound calls between fast and durable.** *When an API change collides with a deadline, you weigh a quick patch against a retry-safe fix and choose the path that keeps customer data safe.*
* **You keep your commitments when priorities compete.** *You juggle a new build, a production fix, and a partner certification, and everyone waiting on you knows when their piece is coming.*
* **You adjust quickly when the ground shifts.** *When a vendor deprecates an endpoint mid-sprint, you re-plan and keep customers connected without them noticing.*
* **You translate between technical and non-technical worlds.** *You explain trade-offs in plain language and bring Product, Support, and customers in early, so what you ship solves the real problem.*

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Payload Integrations
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Payload Integrations team owns everything that connects to the vehicle beyond the base platform. This includes gimbals and EO/IR sensors, arming and fuzing devices, weapons payloads, radios, and other mission hardware. We build the software and interfaces that enable these payloads to reliably run on the vehicle. Nearly every customer program needs a new or modified payload, which makes this team a critical contributor to nearly everything we ship. Our work goes from the lab bench to hardware-in-the-loop testing to live flight, and it has to work in a variety of demanding operational environments.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payload Integrations team. You will design, build, and maintain the software that brings new sensors, communications systems, and mission payloads onto our autonomous vehicles. You will work closely with hardware, electrical, autonomy, and systems engineering teams, as well as outside payload vendors, to turn new hardware into dependable, well-tested components of the vehicle. If you are self-motivated, hold yourself to high standards, enjoy working where software meets hardware, and do well in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

At Mathnasium, we believe every child has the ability to succeed in math—and we're passionate about helping them get there. Through our personalized approach to math learning, we help children build confidence, develop critical thinking skills, and discover what they're capable of.

Behind that mission is a dedicated corporate team working to support our franchise network, strengthen our technology, and help Mathnasium continue to grow. We're looking for a Software Developer who wants to be part of that work.

As a Software Developer at Mathnasium, you'll join a collaborative, hands-on engineering team where your contributions matter. You'll work on applications and services that support our business, deliver meaningful improvements to our users, and help shape how our technology evolves.

We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in software development who is ready to take the next step: owning meaningful work, growing their technical capabilities, and becoming more independent over time. You'll have support from an experienced team, opportunities to contribute ideas, and room to expand your responsibilities as your skills develop.

* Exposure to migrating .NET Framework applications to modern .NET or breaking functionality into independent services.

### **How You'll Grow Here**

At Mathnasium, we want you to build more than features—we want you to build your skills and confidence as a developer.

The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations. Our goal is to make every vehicle a dependable tool for delivering more freshwater where it is needed.

You will own embedded firmware across Rainmaker’s vehicle and its integration with our onboard and ground control software systems. new_jobs.description:
At Auction.com, we’re transforming real estate. As the nation’s leading online platform for buying and selling residential bank-owned and foreclosure properties, we connect buyers, sellers, and investors with innovative technology. With over $70 billion in assets, our success is driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact. We go beyond the bid—empowering our people to thrive and shape the future of the industry
  
  
About the role
  
We run one of the largest digital marketplaces in residential real estate, where buyers, sellers, servicers, and agents transact on real property with real money at stake. Every listing that moves through our platform touches valuation, bidding, contracts, payments, and a long list of external systems, and the platform keeps evolving to meet the needs of the market.
  
We’re hiring full stack engineers to build that platform. You’ll work in React and TypeScript on the front end, Node, Kotlin, and GraphQL services behind it, running on AWS and Kubernetes. You’ll own features end to end: design, build, test, ship, and support them in production.
  
What the work looks like
  
You’ll work in a lean technology org (~50 engineers) which means there is no layer between you and the work that matters. What you build ships.
  
You’ll ship customer-facing features and the services that power them, usually in slices small enough to get in front of users quickly.
  
You’ll test what you build. That means automated coverage at the unit, integration, API, and end-to-end levels, wired into CI so it keeps working after you move on. We don’t hand code to someone else to verify.
  
You’ll debug real problems in production. Distributed systems fail in interesting ways, and figuring out why is part of the job, not an interruption to it.
  
You’ll be in design discussions and code reviews as a participant, not an observer. If you think an approach is wrong, we want to hear it early.
  
You’ll work directly with product, UX, data, and other engineers. Most of the interesting decisions happen in those conversations.
  
You’ll have room to build AI-enabled features. We’re actively putting LLMs into customer and internal workflows, and engineers here are shaping what that looks like.
  
Who does well here
  
The technical bar matters, but these are the traits that actually predict who thrives on this team.
  
You get curious when something doesn’t add up. A weird log line, a metric that moved for no reason, a function nobody can explain. You go find out why instead of routing around it.
  
Blockers are problems, not stop signs. Everyone gets stuck. What matters is what you do in the next hour. You try a few angles, read the source, check the logs, and when you do ask for help you show up with what you’ve already ruled out.
  
You’re still learning. You picked up something new in the last few months, probably because you wanted to rather than because someone assigned it. You can also say “I don’t know” without it costing you anything.
  
You care whether it worked. Not whether the ticket closed, whether the customer’s problem is actually solved.
  
What you bring
  

* Roughly 3+ years building and shipping production software
* React, or another modern component framework you can translate from
* Node.js or Kotlin/Java backend services, with REST or GraphQL APIs
* Hands-on experience in AWS or a comparable cloud
* Enough comfort with Docker and Kubernetes that a container deployment isn’t a black box
* Automated testing as a habit rather than a phase
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, plus relational and NoSQL data stores
* Judgment about performance, scalability, and security, and the instinct to ask about them before shipping

If you have most of this and a track record of picking up the rest quickly, apply anyway. We’d rather hire someone who learns fast than someone who checked every box five years ago.
  
AI and emerging technology
  
You don’t need to be an AI or ML engineer. We’re looking for software engineers who are genuinely curious about this space and want to apply it to real customer problems.
  
**Any of the following is a plus:** LLM and generative AI application work, AI API integrations, AWS Bedrock or comparable platforms, retrieval-augmented generation, conversational interfaces, or agent and workflow automation. Personal projects count.
  
Nice to have
  

* Background in fintech, proptech, real estate, mortgage, lending, payments, e-commerce, or marketplaces
* Experience with high-volume transactional systems
* Microservices, distributed systems, or event-driven architecture
* Experience on a team where engineers owned both delivery and quality

How we engineer
  
Quality is part of engineering, not a separate department. Engineers here test what they build and own it through production.
  
We keep feedback loops short. Trunk-based development, feature flags, small changes, frequent deploys.
  
We prefer clarity over cleverness, in code and in conversation.
  
We hire people who are curious, direct, and accountable, and then give them problems worth solving.
  
  
The good faith base salary [or wage] range for this role at the time of posting and hire is $103,700 – $135,000 per year. Actual compensation offered will be determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and geographic location.
  
  
In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus.
  
  
Auction.com also offers a comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees, including (but not limited to):
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Auction.com contributes an amount equal to 25% of your eligible contributions in our 401k plan.
* Paid Time Off (PTO), including 12 paid holidays.

The availability and value of benefits may vary and are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents.

new_jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**  
  
The Interplanetary Sciences Program was established to expand access to scientific exploration across our solar system. Its mission is to make planetary research faster, more affordable, and more capable than ever before by rethinking how science missions are designed, built, and operated. The program aims to enable scientists to send instruments to distant worlds without decades of development or prohibitive costs. By creating a sustainable model for interplanetary exploration, we are transforming space science from an occasional event into a continuous process of discovery that accelerates knowledge, broadens participation, and inspires the next generation of explorers.

**About the Role:**

  

The Interplanetary Sciences Program is building the operations software that will optimize the mission science and innovate in how we operate the spacecraft. The software will command, monitor, and coordinate the spacecraft, its science instruments, and its communications systems across the Mars 2028 mission. At Relativity Space, we set audacious goals. The Mars 2028 mission is designed to transform how we conduct interplanetary science missions bringing AI models to run on the spacecraft in Mars orbit. The instrument suite will sense the atmosphere to inform weather models and probe the surface with Radar to understand the location of ice. The mission operations for the Mars 2028 mission will also be ground-breaking with automation across the whole stack to enable autonomous science collection meaning the spacecraft can be re-tasked to acquire follow-up observations based on analysis and inference of recent data on the flight hardware.

As a Software Engineer – Operations, you will design and build the tools that mission operators, instrument teams, and external partners rely on every day from command generation and validation, to telemetry and data dissemination, to the interfaces that let outside teams safely and reliably interact with our systems. This is a high ownership and hands-on engineering role at the intersection of software, spacecraft operations, and cross-team collaboration, with real influence over how the mission is run.

Operations software is the layer between a spacecraft hundreds of millions of kilometers away and the humans, instruments, and partner organizations that depend on it working correctly, every time. The tools you build will directly shape how safely and efficiently this mission commands its spacecraft, ingests its science data, and supports the instrument teams counting on us to get it right.

**What You'll Do:**

  

* **Design and implement operations software:** Build, test, and operate spacecraft commanding tools — including command generation, validation, sequencing, and constraint-checking software — using modern engineering practices and AI-assisted / agentic development tools to accelerate implementation without compromising rigor.
* **Work cross-functionally:** partner with mission operations, GN&C, flight software, instrument, and ground systems teams inside Relativity Space, as well as external partners and instrument providers, to translate operational needs into working software.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of software engineering experience, ideally including some exposure to mission operations, ground systems, command and control, or other safety- or mission-critical software

* Experience designing and writing automated test suites (unit, integration, and/or regression tests) for complex or safety-critical systems

As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton is delivering advanced mission planning, digital engineering, and command‑and‑control capabilities supporting the U.S. Government’s space communications enterprise. * Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms,
* Develop microservices and associated service‑to‑service communication patterns.
* Investigate and resolve production issues using structured diagnostic and troubleshooting methods.
* Support customer and partner integration activities as part of platform deployment and capability development.
* Solve complex technical challenges related to secure and scalable satellite communications infrastructure.

* Associate degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related field and 10+ years of relevant experience; OR Bachelor’s degree in a related field and 8+ years of experience; OR Master’s degree in a related field and 6+ years of experience; OR Doctoral degree in a related field and 3+ years of experience. * Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing relational databases, including SQL, triggers, functions, and stored procedures.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms, including RBAC and ABAC.
* Experience with microservice development and backend service architectures.
* Proficiency in developing software using TypeScript, including use of modern language features, strong type checking, and practices that support maintainable and reliable code.
* Experience developing and building front‑end applications using Vite and associated modern web development tools.
* Experience with contemporary front‑end development practices, including component‑based architecture, state management techniques, application routing, and responsive design.
* Experience using Git‑based source control systems and participating in structured code review processes.
* Experience investigating and resolving production issues in operational environments.
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and automated test workflows.
* Working knowledge of PKI concepts and asynchronous messaging architectures.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, OAuth 2.0, JWT, Git, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, Kafka, and Unix shell scripting.
* Experience applying Zero Trust software development principles.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm for containerized deployment and orchestration.
* Experience with at least one major commercial cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

**Desired qualifications:**

* Ability to effectively collaborate with MBSE and Test engineering teams.
* Ability to prepare and present technical designs and recommendations to cross‑functional stakeholders.
* Ability to engage with end‑users to clarify requirements or support implementation activities.
* Ability to learn new tools, technologies, or frameworks in support of evolving project needs.

**Benefits:**

Peraton offers enhanced benefits to employees working on this critical National Security program, which include heavily subsidized employee benefits coverage for you and your dependents, 25 days of PTO

new_jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Platform
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PLATFORM**

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world's largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX
* Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates
* Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints
* Own all aspects of software engineering and product development
* Deep dive into your users' problems to find and create efficient solutions
* Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software development; OR 7+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
* 3+ years of professional experience in full stack development

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language
* 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications
* Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts
* Expertise in designing software systems
* Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring
* Expertise in profiling and improving application performance
* Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)
* Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them
* Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies
* Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
* Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* You may be asked to work extended hours/weekends dependent on launch cadence

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**  
  
Pay Range:  
Sr. Software Engineer: $165,000.00 - $230,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Robotics Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

Octavian Robotics is solving the #1 complication in the $3T surgical industry. We are building robots for the sterilization of surgical tools. Only now with generalized robotics models have we been able to tackle this problem and save lives.

This company is a spin-out from Sorting Robotics and we are inheriting a decade of robotics infrastructure and know-how. **The role is for the first robotics software engineer at the company.** You'll be working directly with the founders and learning from the previous team on how to build a robotics company. You'll need to be scrappy, a jack of all trades and a master of one, be able to communicate your ideas quickly and effectively, adapt to changing dynamics, have experience with robotics, and be able to push through the journey of building a new company.

This role is not for the faint of heart. You should expect to work 60+ hours a week, expect for there to be more problems than solutions, expect for you to have very little hand-holding, invent technology that didn't exist 6 months ago, expect to feel the pressure of performance when everyone in the room is depending on you and there are millions of dollars on the line. All this will be true, but you will also be in a room of people that respect you; where everyone is rowing together to achieve the noble goal of saving lives with our robotic systems.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement software to control machines developed by Octavian Robotics.
* Build and implement the initial infrastructure of the company.
* Work closely with mechanical and electrical engineers and guide design decisions based on what software can effectively accomplish.
* Work closely with customer success and sales staff to translate customer and company needs into software solutions.
* Train entry/mid-level software developers in the development lifecycle of the product lines you're working on.
* Work with engineers and customer success staff to remote and debug logs in the machine and understand customer problems.
* This is an on-site position. You're expected to work on-site with the other team members five days a week. We are based in Los Angeles.

Sometimes, nothing will work, and you'll need to conduct experiments until the problem's root cause (hardware or software-related) is fully understood.

Before writing any code, you must deeply understand complex topics and communicate proposed solutions to a highly technical team. Ideally, you write the minimum number of lines that solve the problem ("spin lock? Why not? It solves this problem" - "I'll just use a JSON file for now as a database so anyone can easily modify it").

Your work will be focused more on clear communication and business impact than on lines of code you can write or cool tech you can use.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Python
* Familiarity with Git
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, AWS services
* Familiarity with web standards, RESTful APIs, OAuth
* Experience training VLA or inference models for motor control

You will work on different parts of the stack at various times. We expect you to understand where everything goes and why, and we expect you to add to the stack to make the development process more robust.

 **Requirements**  

* Must be AI-Native in all workflows
* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
* Experience with Linux (systemd, journalctl, network manager, permissions).
* Hands-on experience in robotics or computer vision
* Experience working with Hardware.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship.

  
**Benefits**  

* $170,000 - $190,000 per year full-time salary.
* 0.5% - 1% equity.
* Health, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending account, paid time off, parental leave.
* Schedule: 12-hour shift, Monday - Saturday. This job is not for the weak of heart.
* In person, Van Nuys or Los Angeles, CA. Relocation package available.

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer I
new_jobs.description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

**Full Stack Software Engineer I**

Parallel Systems is seeking a Software Engineer I to join our Interfaces team. The Interfaces team builds the software people use to operate, monitor, and manage our vehicles and fleet, including our main operator application and the product surfaces that will grow into enterprise customer software. This is a junior role with real ownership. You do not need years of production experience, but you do need high agency, clear communication, and the hunger to learn fast. We care more about how you work than how many years you have been paid to work.

**Responsibilities:**

* Build and improve the operator and customer product platform in TypeScript, React, and Rust.
* Ship features in our Electron operator application.
* Work with product and vehicle/systems engineers to turn operational needs into clear, reliable interfaces.
* Own features end-to-end: understand the user, implement, test, document, and follow through after merge.
* Grow into full-stack product work as we expand enterprise software, including data models, APIs, and the performance and reliability of software that talks to the real world.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **After 30 Days:** You've set up your environment, learned how operators use our application, and shipped your first changes to the software platform. You're asking good questions early and building relationships with product and vehicle/systems engineers.
* **After 60 Days:** You've owned a feature end-to-end, from understanding the operator's need through implementation, testing, documentation, and follow-through after merge. You're reading and improving code across the Interfaces codebase.

At Auction.com, we’re transforming real estate. As the nation’s leading online platform for buying and selling residential bank-owned and foreclosure properties, we connect buyers, sellers, and investors with innovative technology. With over $70 billion in assets, our success is driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact. We go beyond the bid—empowering our people to thrive and shape the future of the industry
  
  
About the role
  
We run one of the largest digital marketplaces in residential real estate, where buyers, sellers, servicers, and agents transact on real property with real money at stake. Every listing that moves through our platform touches valuation, bidding, contracts, payments, and a long list of external systems, and the platform keeps evolving to meet the needs of the market.
  
We're hiring Senior Full Stack Software Engineers to help build and evolve that platform. You'll work in React and TypeScript on the front end, with Node, Kotlin, and GraphQL services behind it, running on AWS and Kubernetes.
  
At the senior level, you'll own complex features and technical solutions end to end—from design and architecture through build, test, deployment, and production support. You'll also help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful design decisions, code reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership.
  
What the work looks like
  
You'll work in a lean technology organization (~50 engineers), which means there isn't a lot of distance between you and the work that matters.
  
What you build ships.
  
You'll design and deliver customer-facing features and the services that power them, balancing speed with scalability, maintainability, and long-term technical health.
  
You'll help shape technical approaches before development begins—identifying tradeoffs, challenging assumptions, and helping the team make sound architecture and design decisions.
  
You'll test what you build, with automated coverage across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing wired into CI. We don't hand code to someone else to verify.
  
You'll debug complex production issues across distributed systems and help identify root causes, not just short-term fixes.
  
You'll be an active voice in design discussions and code reviews. Senior engineers here are expected to bring perspective, challenge approaches when needed, and help other engineers get better.
  
You'll work directly with product, UX, data, and other engineers. Many of the most important technical and product decisions happen in those conversations.
  
You'll also have room to build AI-enabled features. We're actively incorporating LLMs into customer and internal workflows, and engineers here are helping shape what that looks like.
  
Who does well here
  
You get curious when something doesn't add up. A weird log line, a metric that moved unexpectedly, or a function nobody can explain—you go find out why instead of routing around it.
  
You take ownership. Blockers are problems to solve, and you're comfortable navigating ambiguity, evaluating options, and moving work forward.
  
You have strong technical judgment. You know when a simple solution is enough and when scalability, performance, security, or architecture requires deeper thinking.
  
You make the engineers around you better. You share context, provide thoughtful code reviews, mentor others, and help establish good engineering practices without needing a formal leadership title.
  
You're still learning. Technology changes quickly, and you're genuinely interested in learning new tools and approaches—including AI—and applying them where they make sense.
  
You care whether it worked. Not whether the ticket closed, but whether the customer's problem was actually solved.
  
What you bring
  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications
* Strong experience with React and TypeScript, or comparable modern front-end technologies
* Experience building backend services with Node.js, Kotlin/Java, or similar technologies
* Experience designing and working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs
* Hands-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform
* Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Strong automated testing practices across unit, integration, API, and/or end-to-end testing
* Experience with CI/CD and modern software delivery practices
* Experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable, distributed production systems
* Strong judgment around performance, scalability, reliability, and security
* Ability to independently own complex technical work from design through production
* Experience mentoring engineers, contributing to code/design reviews, and helping improve engineering practices

If you have most of this and a track record of picking up the rest quickly, apply anyway. We'd rather hire someone who continues to learn than someone who simply checked every box five years ago.
  
AI and emerging technology
  
You don't need to be an AI or ML engineer. We're looking for senior software engineers who are genuinely curious about this space and want to apply it to real customer and business problems.
  
**Any of the following is a plus:** LLM and generative AI application development, AI API integrations, AWS Bedrock or comparable platforms, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational interfaces, or agent and workflow automation. Personal projects count.
  
Nice to have
  

* Background in fintech, proptech, real estate, mortgage, lending, payments, e-commerce, or marketplaces
* Experience with high-volume transactional systems
* Microservices, distributed systems, or event-driven architecture
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or services
* Experience on a team where engineers owned both delivery and quality

new_jobs.description:
Rim Universe is building an AI-native platform for animated and serialized video content creation. Our platform helps creators transform ideas and scripts into structured production workflows, including story development, character creation, episode and shot planning, AI image/video generation, and editing.

We are currently expanding our engineering team and looking for a **Backend Engineer** to help build the core backend infrastructure powering our platform. If you're passionate about AI video creation, we'd love to have you join our team and help turn more great stories into amazing videos!

About the Role

As a Backend Engineer at Rim Universe, you will be responsible for building and maintaining backend systems supporting **AI model integrations, generation workflows, media asset management, and user/project data**.

You will work closely with our AI and product teams to build reliable, scalable backend services that support AI-powered content generation in a production environment.

Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services using **Python and FastAPI**
* Build and maintain **REST APIs** for our platform
* Integrate third-party APIs, including **LLM, image generation, and video generation models**
* Design and optimize **PostgreSQL** databases and queries
* Build asynchronous AI generation workflows, including task queues, status tracking, retries, failure handling, and webhooks
* Develop backend systems for users, projects, generated content, and media assets
* Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot services in **Docker/Linux** environments
* Improve system reliability, scalability, maintainability, and performance
* Collaborate with AI, frontend, and product team members to deliver production-ready features

Requirements

* **2+ years** of backend development experience, with at least one project taken through development, launch and ongoing maintenance.
* Strong **Python** skills and hands-on production experience with **FastAPI** or **Django**. Able to quickly read and maintain an existing codebase.
* Experience with **PostgreSQL**, database design, and SQL optimization.
* Understands how background job systems work: job state machines, **leases and heartbeats**, timeouts, **retries**, **idempotency** and **failure recovery**. Familiar with reliable messaging patterns such as the **transactional outbox**. Has used **Redis** (Streams, locks or queues).
* Experience integrating **third-party HTTP APIs**, including authentication, **async callbacks**, **status polling**, **rate limiting** and **error classification**. Understands why a **pay-per-call API** must not be blindly retried when the outcome of a call is unknown.
* Experience with **LLM API** integration, **prompt template** management or **agent** development.
* Familiar with object storage such as **S3** or **MinIO**: **presigned URLs**, uploads and downloads, and **access control**. Able to guarantee **multi-tenant data isolation**.
* Comfortable with **Linux**, **Docker / Docker Compose** and **Git**. Able to investigate logs, manage secrets, run backup and restore, and write tests for critical flows.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on work on **AI video, image or speech generation**, or audio/video processing; familiarity with **FFmpeg**.
* Experience with the **ComfyUI API** or building **multi-step generation workflows** (e.g. speech synthesis → video generation → lip sync).
* Experience building **Stripe** payments, subscriptions, credit ledgers or usage-based billing.
* Experience optimizing generation job performance, analyzing model costs or planning service capacity.
* Working knowledge of **Node.js / TypeScript** (our frontend BFF uses Next.js).
* Experience with global SaaS products.

You should think beyond simply implementing APIs and consider system reliability, maintainability, scalability, and production performance when designing solutions.

  + Solid understanding of API design and implementation (REST, GraphQL).

new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About The Team**
------------------

The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.

**About the Job**
-----------------

Sentry Towers are robotic systems: motors, cameras, radars, radios, and sensor boards, running on NVIDIA Jetson compute in the field. Verifying that a system like this works means accounting for physical actuation, real sensor data, and hardware that fails in ways no unit test anticipates. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own our simulation and hardware test infrastructure and make automated, whole-system testing the default for everything we ship. A regression that escapes here does not surface on a developer's laptop. It surfaces on a tower at a site someone has to fly to, guarding a perimeter that does not pause while we debug.

You will work across both halves of the problem. Our software-in-the-loop environments are declaratively defined multi-node virtual towers, complete with a simulated ground control station, synthetic sensor feeds, and a game-engine-driven world, which lets us run whole-system scenarios in CI with no hardware attached. Our hardware-in-the-loop side drives real Jetson-based towers through a board test server: provisioning them over the network, flashing firmware, installing full system images, and reporting results back through our CI pipeline on a nightly and weekend cadence.

Both foundations are in place and working, so you are inheriting infrastructure rather than starting from nothing. What does not exist yet is most of what sits on top: the functional test suites, the scenario library, and the diagnostic tooling that turn a booting tower into a verified one are yours to design. Firmware integration, compute platform bring-up, and both our Air Defense and Counter-Intrusion business lines depend on this capability, and what you build becomes the standard they test against.

Test infrastructure is a job where the wins are invisible and the failures are loud. You will spend real time on work nobody asks for by name: chasing intermittent failures to root cause instead of retrying them, waiting on hardware that is scarce and shared, and rebuilding coverage when a compute generation changes underneath you. The measure of the role is bugs that never reach a tower, which means much of your best work leaves no trace anyone thanks you for.

Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/sentry

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own and grow our SITL environments: add product variants and scenarios, keep the simulated sensor and video pipelines faithful enough to be trustworthy, and keep whole-system test runtimes short enough to fit inside a normal development cycle.
* Build out functional coverage on the HITL bench across the behavior that matters: motion control and trajectory execution, camera and sensor bring-up, firmware update paths, network failover, and clean recovery from power loss and unexpected reboots.
* Own the CI integration end to end: scheduling, dependency chaining between test stages, artifact and log capture, result reporting, and the flake triage that keeps a hardware pipeline trusted instead of ignored.
* Grow the test platform continuously as the product line does. New compute generations, new payloads, and new product variants each need coverage, and keeping the framework ahead of the roadmap is the enduring core of this role.
* Make failures diagnosable without touching the rig. Invest in log capture, serial console capture, and test artifacts so an engineer can root-cause from the CI output alone.
* Partner with hardware and manufacturing engineers to stand up the physical HITL benches, specifying the fixtures, switching, power control, and instrumentation needed to exercise towers unattended. This is a substantial upfront build with periodic expansion as new hardware arrives.
* Partner with firmware, platform, and business line teams so they can add their own tests against your framework, and support them as their first users.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* 4+ years of professional software engineering, with meaningful time spent building test infrastructure, CI systems, or simulation for systems that involve real hardware.
* Proficiency in Python for test authoring and automation, plus working ability in Rust or C++ to read and debug the services under test.
* Demonstrated experience automating tests against physical hardware: device provisioning, remote power and reset control, serial consoles, network booting, or instrumented benches.
* Strong CI/CD engineering skills, including pipelines with expensive stages, hardware resource contention, and scheduled rather than per-commit execution.

At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

Mindbody equips wellness entrepreneurs with technology to support thriving businesses and create exceptional experiences. Innovation and curiosity drive our culture, connecting businesses and individuals through cutting-edge solutions. Join us if you're passionate about enhancing wellness through technology.

**Your role**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a crucial leadership role in building scalable systems for the Mindbody ecosystem. You'll exercise autonomy in decision-making, take ownership of large technical projects, and provide leadership within your team and across engineering. You proactively identify and solve challenges your squad is facing, often leading medium-to-large features and cross-team efforts. You act as a multiplier for your team, mentoring engineers, sharing best practices, and contributing to a culture of growth and learning. You'll pursue continuous improvement to help Mindbody achieve its mission: Powering the world's fitness and wellness businesses and connecting them with more consumers, more effectively, than anyone else

You'll likely spend time working on

* Leading discussions with Product, Design, and QA to iterate on the design, implementation and deployment of our product.
* Build, maintain, and own backend systems and applications.
* Seeking different perspectives and soliciting honest feedback
* Practice engineering best practices (e.g., automated testing, code reviews, proper monitoring) while guiding others on their adoption, and contributing thoughtful, timely feedback during peer reviews.
* Mentoring and leading through code reviews, teaching best practices, and conducting technical interviews for engineers and managers.
* Leading retrospectives and incident postmortems for your squad.
* Helping attract and retain talent by building community inside and outside the organization
* Care about our studio partners and want to help them grow their business
* Take delight in delighting our users.

About the right team member

You love to design robust and easy to use APIs and services taking ownership of technical decisions. You're capable of leading complex technical projects with high levels of uncertainty, scale, and interdependencies—creating timelines, delegating tasks, and ensuring smooth launches. You learn quickly and ramp up on new systems, languages, or frameworks with minimal guidance. You're not afraid to ask questions early and often in unfamiliar territory. You are a sought-after contributor in code reviews, helping elevate code quality through timely and constructive feedback. You are an expert in one or more technical areas and are recognized within your team as a trusted source of insights and mentorship.

At Playlist we value people who are intellectually curious, who are pragmatic not dogmatic, and people who care about our product, their teammates, and their own personal growth. We are faced with an interesting set of technical challenges, and we believe in giving our engineers the autonomy to go and solve them. Much of our team comes from non-traditional computing backgrounds; we know that by bringing together a diverse set of voices we'll be able to build a better product, and a better company. * Experience building backend services with an object-oriented language such as C# or Java.
* Experience designing and architecting backend services.

* Experience with monitoring systems such as New Relic or Kibana.

* Experience reviewing new feature impact on an application and recognizing potential risks.

* Strong understanding of SQL and relational dat

**Build the platform that will power every type of financial institution onboarding**

Prelim is seeking a **Software Engineer, Product** to join our rapidly growing and fully remote US team. You'll have the opportunity to architect and build the platform that handles every conceivable type of financial institution onboarding, from simple deposit accounts to complex treasury services for millions of people. If you're passionate about solving massive-scale engineering challenges and eager to be part of a fast-paced remote startup culture, we encourage you to apply to join our team today!

As a **Software Engineer, Product** at Prelim, you will own critical parts of the platform that powers digital onboarding for financial institutions across the world. You'll work directly with our customers, product team, and engineering leadership to build systems that handle everything from online deposit account opening to in-branch experiences, account maintenance, treasury services onboarding, credit card applications, and every other type of financial institution onboarding imaginable.

**This isn't just another full-stack role, it's the chance to build the infrastructure that millions depend on.**  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Architect and build features across our entire stack handling massive scale and complexity.
* Build, enhance and fix the systems that seamlessly integrate with legacy bank infrastructure, core banking systems, and third-party compliance providers.
* Solve complex technical challenges around multi-tenant architecture, real-time data processing, and bank-grade reliability requirements.
* Work directly with major banks to understand their unique onboarding requirements and translate complex business logic into elegant technical solutions.
* Own the performance, scalability, and reliability of systems processing millions of applications across hundreds of different banking products.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience with modern web technologies (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL preferred). Whether you're a new graduate with impressive projects or an experienced engineer, we want to hear from you.
* Strong system design skills and experience with scalable architectures, you'll be building systems that immediately help millions.
* You thrive on solving complex technical problems with business context. You can break down complicated banking requirements and build elegant solutions.
* You care about business impact and can balance technical excellence with shipping features that move the business forward.
* You think deeply about user experience, whether you're building for every day people opening accounts or bank employees processing applications.
* You're excited about working directly with customers, understanding their complex needs, and iterating quickly based on feedback.
* You want to own significant parts of the product and help shape technical decisions as we scale.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States and located within the continental United States

**About Prelim**

Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation.

We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company retreats.

Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

Compensation Range: $140K - $230K
